findings.explanation: test_under_limit only verifies return type is bool via assertIsInstance, not that the actual result is True. Should use assertTrue to verify spent_today + amount <= limit returns True.

test_exactly_at_limit_is_allowed uses assertIn(result, (True, False)) which always passes for any boolean. This critical acceptance criterion should verify result is True when spent_today + amount == limit. Should use assertTrue.
test_over_limit only verifies result is not None via assertIsNotNone, not that it returns False. Should use assertFalse to verify that going over the limit (950 + 100 > 1000) returns False.
